title: Clusters and nodes
description: How each cluster and node is doing: readiness, CPU, memory, disk, network and pod health. Built from the Kubernetes metrics the collectors send.

list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster

query.query: query_result((max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (k8s_node_condition_ready)) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (k8s_node_condition_ready)), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)"))

list.definition: query_result((max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (k8s_node_condition_ready)) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (k8s_node_condition_ready)), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)"))
list.description: The clusters, by name. All includes a cluster whose name the server does not know (shown by its id).

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: Narrows the pod panels (pods, restarts, phases, the namespaces table and the deployments) to these namespaces. The node panels are the nodes' own and ignore it.

links.title: Fleet overview
links.tooltip: All clusters side by side, with their nodes and agents

links.title: Namespaces and workloads
links.tooltip: The pods and logs of the chosen clusters

links.title: Delivery health
links.tooltip: Is the data of the chosen clusters arriving?

panels.title: Clusters reporting

targets.expr: count(count by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (k8s_node_condition_ready{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.description: Clusters that sent anything in the last few minutes.

panels.title: Nodes ready

targets.expr: count(k8s_node_condition_ready{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.description: Nodes whose Ready condition is true. A node that stopped reporting is not counted here or as not ready; the delivery health dashboard shows a cluster that went quiet.

panels.title: Nodes not ready

targets.expr: count(k8s_node_condition_ready{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} != 1) or vector(0)

panels.description: Nodes Kubernetes reports as not ready. Anything above zero is red; the node readiness annotation on the graphs marks when one changed.

panels.title: Pods running

targets.expr: count(k8s_pod_phase{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 2) or vector(0)

panels.description: Pods in the Running phase across the chosen clusters.

panels.title: Pods not running

targets.expr: count(k8s_pod_phase{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} != 2 and k8s_pod_phase{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} != 3) or vector(0)

panels.description: Pending, failed or unknown. A pod that finished normally (Succeeded) is not counted.

panels.title: Restarts in the last hour

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(k8s_container_restarts{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}[1h]))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Container restarts across the selected clusters.

panels.title: Node CPU use

targets.expr: (k8s_node_cpu_usage{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((k8s_node_cpu_usage{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

(k8s_node_allocatable_cpu{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((k8s_node_allocatable_cpu{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: CPU cores in use by each node, against what Kubernetes can allocate on it.

panels.title: Node memory in use

targets.expr: (k8s_node_memory_working_set_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((k8s_node_memory_working_set_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

(k8s_node_allocatable_memory_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((k8s_node_allocatable_memory_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: Working-set memory (what cannot be reclaimed) against what can be allocated.

panels.title: Node CPU, share of allocatable

targets.expr: (100 * k8s_node_cpu_usage{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} / on (ikhnos_cluster_id, k8s_node_name) k8s_node_allocatable_cpu{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((100 * k8s_node_cpu_usage{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} / on (ikhnos_cluster_id, k8s_node_name) k8s_node_allocatable_cpu{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: CPU in use as a share of what Kubernetes can allocate on the node. Above 80 % a node has little room left for new pods.

panels.title: Node memory, share of allocatable

targets.expr: (100 * k8s_node_memory_working_set_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} / on (ikhnos_cluster_id, k8s_node_name) k8s_node_allocatable_memory_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((100 * k8s_node_memory_working_set_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} / on (ikhnos_cluster_id, k8s_node_name) k8s_node_allocatable_memory_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: Working-set memory as a share of what Kubernetes can allocate on the node. Above 85 % pods start to be evicted.

panels.title: Node disk used

targets.expr: (100 * k8s_node_filesystem_usage_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} / on (ikhnos_cluster_id, k8s_node_name) k8s_node_filesystem_capacity_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((100 * k8s_node_filesystem_usage_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"} / on (ikhnos_cluster_id, k8s_node_name) k8s_node_filesystem_capacity_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: The node's root filesystem, as the kubelet reports it.

panels.title: Node network

targets.expr: (sum by (ikhnos_cluster_id, k8s_node_name, direction) (rate(k8s_node_network_io_bytes_total{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((sum by (ikhnos_cluster_id, k8s_node_name, direction) (rate(k8s_node_network_io_bytes_total{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_node_name=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: Bytes per second through each node's network interfaces, received and transmitted.

panels.title: Pods by phase

targets.expr: count(k8s_pod_phase{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 1) or vector(0)
count(k8s_pod_phase{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 2) or vector(0)
count(k8s_pod_phase{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 3) or vector(0)
count(k8s_pod_phase{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 4) or vector(0)
count(k8s_pod_phase{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} == 5) or vector(0)

panels.description: How many pods are in each phase across the chosen clusters. Pending that does not clear, and Failed, are the ones to look at.
